title: How Tony Teshara built Contrario’s LATAM engineering vertical
summary: Twelve months on Contrario, 30+ engineers placed at 20+ startups. How talent broker Tony Teshara and Tecmo bring LATAM engineers to US founders.
body_markdown: Contrario isn’t just built for expert recruiters like Tony. It’s empowered and improved by every action they take. Last August, Tony flagged that recruiters were getting interview alerts for candidates who’d already been hired. Our CTO, Aditya Sood, had the team change how it closes out every hire that same day. From live searches, Tony has also recommended several features now in production at Contrario: full interview visibility on the dashboard, recruiters copied on every candidate email, and a way to open a role to other recruiters when a client’s pipeline backs up.
